celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا﴾: followed it, rising when it sets,

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا﴾ by its rising high,

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا﴾: covers it with its darkness. «إذا» in the three [places] is purely adverbial (li-mujarrad al-ẓarfiyya), and the governing word (ʿāmil) in it is the verb of the oath.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَنَفْسٍ﴾, in the sense of «نفوس» ("souls"), ﴿وَمَا سَوَّاهَا﴾ in creation. «ما» in the three [places] is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun) or in the sense of «من» ("who").

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا﴾: He made clear to it the way of good and of evil. «التقوى» was placed later in observance of the verse-endings. And the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam) is:

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿قَدْ أَفْلَحَ﴾ — the lām has been dropped from it because of the length of the speech — ﴿مَنْ زَكَّاهَا﴾: purified it from sins,

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَقَدْ خَابَ﴾: has lost ﴿مَنْ دَسَّاهَا﴾: concealed it through disobedience. Its original form is «دسّسها»; the second sīn was replaced with an alif for lightness.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ﴾ their messenger Ṣāliḥ ﴿بِطَغْوَاهَا﴾: because of their transgression,

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿إِذِ انْبَعَثَ﴾: hastened ﴿أَشْقَاهَا﴾ — his name was Qudār — to hamstring the she-camel, with their consent.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ﴾ Ṣāliḥ: ﴿نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ﴾, that is, leave her alone, ﴿وَسُقْيَاهَا﴾: her drinking on her day; she had a day and they had a day.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾ in that statement of his from Allah, upon which the descent of punishment on them was made consequent if they disobeyed him; ﴿فَعَقَرُوهَا﴾: they killed her so that the water she drank would be left safely to them. ﴿فَدَمْدَمَ﴾: covered over ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ﴾ the punishment ﴿بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا﴾, that is, the covering over them, that is, He encompassed them all with it, so not one of them escaped.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَلَا﴾ — with wāw and with fāʾ — ﴿يَخَافُ﴾ He, Exalted is He, ﴿عُقْبَاهَا﴾: its consequence.
